shortDesc: Two gamification products built end to end with AI — front end, back end, database — for 1,200+ live players.
longDesc: Two real-world gamification products for FANOS, Coin98's fan app — designed and built end to end by me with AI coding agents: player apps, staff and admin tools, venue screens, back end, database, deployment and live operations. Conviction Explorer turned a two-day crypto conference into a mission-and-reward game; Xoay Tròn × FANOS gave Hoàng Dũng's 10,000-guest concert an XP-gated prize wheel.

images.caption: Staff Scanner App and Admin Console

contributions.title: AI-Built, End to End
contributions.desc: Designed and built both products myself with AI coding agents (Claude Code): React 19 + TypeScript front end, Fastify API, PostgreSQL with Drizzle migrations, FANOS SSO, rotating HMAC QR codes, staff and admin tools, automated tests, and cloud deploy on Vercel, Railway and Supabase. 12 weeks · 1,370+ commits · 140+ merged PRs · 135 test files · ~28k lines of TypeScript. Xoay Tròn went from design to show night in about 12 days, with me running the event-night command room.

contributions.title: Event Ops Tooling
contributions.desc: Built the tools that ran both events live. Conviction: a staff app for 221 booth accounts (scan rotating player QR codes, award mission points, redeem gifts and spins at the counter), an admin console (live dashboard, missions, gift stock, players, e-lottery tickets, config, data export), a booth LED controller and an offline stage-draw tool. Xoay Tròn: a staff app with Ticket / Merch / Spin tabs, a 16:9 prize-wheel kiosk, a projector leaderboard and a web admin to edit prize weights and quotas live, without a deploy.

contributions.title: Conviction Explorer · Results
contributions.desc: Designed the full mission → points → reward loop for Conviction 2026 (Ho Chi Minh City, 14–15 Aug): 1,201 active players (87.7% of sign-ups), 15,922 missions completed (13.3 per player), 18,132 QR scans at 98.2% success and a 135-minute average dwell time.

contributions.title: Points Economy & Reward Pricing
contributions.desc: Priced 24 missions (2,050 points max) and every reward sink — merch, spins, e-lottery — with a supply/demand simulator of light, medium and heavy players. Points landed at 31.9% gifts, 26.8% lottery and 23.0% spins, with only 18.2% left unspent.

contributions.title: Xoay Tròn × FANOS

contributions.title: Prize Logic & Fairness
contributions.desc: Balanced a 3,578-prize pool across 9 tiers with per-window quotas, sold-out redistribution and server-authoritative draws. Wheel slices reflect real odds; validated with Monte Carlo simulation, load tests and anti-fraud rules for ticket uploads.
